reference_sql:
WITH may_not_june AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
  EXCEPT
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
    AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers
FROM may_not_june
